authority.implementation: Blocked until architect wire freeze, NI2-011 accepted, and Root implementation release

native_wire.types: strict integers/booleans, canonical finite JSON, UTF8 bounded text; no coercion
native_wire.client_boundary: Independent client models; no server imports. Standard TaskRun subtree uses existing actual server-dump/client-validate exception, native outer fields exact schema parity.

signatures.SealedStreamGraph.start: @sync_compatible async def start(self, *, timeout: float | None = None) -> RunningStreamGraph
signatures.RunningStreamGraph.wait: @sync_compatible async def wait(self, timeout: float | None = None) -> StreamDAGExecution
signatures.RunningStreamGraph.cancel: @sync_compatible async def cancel(self, *, reason: str = 'Cancellation requested for stream graph') -> NoReturn

public.behavior: Sync Flow blocks; async Flow awaits the same names. No implicit seal/start/wait. No public activate/fail/admit/collection.
public.identity: Preserve Sealed(graph_revision_id, graph_digest) construction. Trusted Flow registry binds routing_digest, Flow identity/API and frozen operation intents. Running handle contains graph_revision_id/graph_digest/routing_digest only; no live client or credentials.
public.start: Explicitly admits, observes all ready, commits activation, returns Running handle only on ACTIVE. Startup errors use phase-safe fail. START timeout uses the same stable START_TIMEOUT fail and verified cleanup, never releases capacity by deadline.
public.wait: Observation only. Timeout raises without control mutation. Return bounded execution summary only after normal terminal cleanup; failure/cancellation propagate standard FailedRun/cancellation after verified cleanup.
public.cancel: Journal once; after exact cleanup server commits FlowCancelled and caller propagates standard cancellation signal, never returns normally. No fabricated cancellation when normal completion won: typed TERMINAL_CONFLICT.
public.abort_preview: Explicit metadata abandonment only while SEALED/unassigned with no grants/DATA/receipts/slots. Graph terminal FAILED with PREVIEW_ABORT; Flow remains Running.
public.normal_flow_exit: SEALED unused preview auto-aborts before Flow completion. Normally terminal/clean graph deregisters. STOPPING joins and observes its persisted control and propagates that outcome; it never creates conflicting FAIL. STARTING/ACTIVE with no control is abandoned-lifecycle error: stable phase-safe FAIL plus verified cleanup, then Flow fails; no silent auto-wait.
public.exceptional_flow_exit: Cleanup committed phase and re-raise original exception; join existing control if STOPPING. An authoritative CANCEL propagates cancellation rather than rewriting the outcome. Already released graph deregisters; later plain Python failure belongs to ordinary Flow engine.

flow_retry_guard.predicate: retries is not None and flow.run_count <= retries
flow_retry_guard.allowed: None/0 or exhausted final attempt; no policy rewrite
flow_retry_guard.reason: A later Python failure after wait or preview abort must not auto-retry into the released one-lifetime graph. Internal metadata helpers and P2 unchanged.

public.finite_tail: DAG handles/leaf collections remain typed unsupported as ordinary finite Task dependencies. Plain Python may inspect bounded metadata after successful wait.

parent_dto.StreamDAGActivateRequest: StreamDAGOperationRequest exactly; no grant/readiness/target set from client
parent_dto.StreamDAGFailRequest: StreamDAGOperationRequest + failure_kind: FLOW_SCOPE_EXCEPTION | START_EXCEPTION | START_TIMEOUT | COORDINATOR_ERROR; no arbitrary error/expected_phase/targets

StreamDAGExecutionCounts.tags_remaining: strict nonnegative allocation count; may exceed N

lifecycle.persisted_graph: Reuse SEALED/ADMITTED/ABORTING/RELEASED; derive phase, no parallel phase column
lifecycle.transitions: SEALED->PREVIEW; atomic start admission->STARTING; complete ready-set activation CAS->ACTIVE; persisted control->STOPPING; exact stopped/retired complete attempt sets and resources released->TERMINAL
lifecycle.activation: CODE_READY is same-child cap-free code/config preflight only. Then claim/register, private scoped bootstrap, independent retained-Task/bootstrap/PID validation, signed BOOTSTRAP_READY. Server derives all N current ready grants; activation receipt persists readiness_set_digest. Only committed ACTIVE causes private worker GO.
lifecycle.replacement: Append launch attempt and new grant. New own BOOTSTRAP_READY before own GO/DATA, without resetting global activation or fencing siblings.
lifecycle.normal: Normal verified retirement also requires COMPLETE CLOSED launch-attempt set/digest before physical release. Persist terminal FINALIZE outcome/summary/basis after all terminal/EOF/retirement conditions. Graph completes; Flow stays Running. GET/wait never mutates.
lifecycle.control_terminal: Last exact STOP commits FlowCancelled or Failed(retriable=False), CoreFlowPolicy force=False, after all physical proofs. Task retry unchanged.
lifecycle.convergence: Same-effective FAIL controls join canonical signed-child FAIL or STARTING worker STARTUP_ABORT; parent action receipt points to existing control, first cause immutable. Opposite CANCEL/FAIL -> CONTROL_CONFLICT.
lifecycle.terminal_race: Current auth first. Exact known op returns original receipt plus current terminal execution. New fail/cancel after TERMINAL -> TERMINAL_CONFLICT, no receipt/mutation. Signed terminal Task event still accepted under existing CANCEL without creating FAIL or rewriting accepted EOF.
lifecycle.terminal_auth: Narrow same Flow attempt/run_count + graph/current authority TERMINAL|RELEASED access for GET execution and exact known-op replay; new mutations, stale run_count and foreign Flow refuse.
lifecycle.locks: Flow/authority/graph then sorted workers then subtask/grant/TaskRun/streams. DATA holds shared prefix through transaction. Signed failed event acquires graph UPDATE before Task/grant locks, never SHARE->UPDATE upgrade after Task lock; does not require output already FAILED.

operations.retry: Validate/deep-copy finite JSON and freeze canonical UTF8 bytes before first await. Same operation/body/authority on unknown ACK; no new UUID, route recomputation or client phase choice. Cache first parent fail intent for later finalizer replay.
operations.receipt: Immutable accepted receipt and request/outcome digests; execution/current attempt/disposition may progress. Auth before lookup; changed material same op conflicts.
operations.authority: Public mutations require protected API + current Flow execution authority. Runtime-only activate/fail means no public handle methods, not a new security principal.

child_dto.StreamDAGSubtaskBootstrap: Own immutable task/config/parameters, NI011 context, own input projection or null, own output projection, current grant/registered identity, bootstrap_digest, standard TaskRun. No sibling parameters/capability/private key.
child_dto.bootstrap_digest: ONE versioned canonical immutable witness: Flow/attempt, graph/routing, assignment/subtask/index/parallelism/operator/ports/subscriber/edge/streams, task identity/manifest/dynamic key/frozen config/own parameters, assigned worker generation, grant/epoch/holder/scope/eventkey, journal-recorded PID/ticks. Exclude mutable TaskRun state/counts/timestamps.
child_dto.ready_signature: Domain prefect-dag-bootstrap-ready-v1; canonical op+graph/assignment/subtask/currentgrant/epoch+holder/scope/eventkey+registered PID/ticks+bootstrap_digest; independently derived server-side
child_dto.StreamDAGActivationObservation: graph_revision_id,subtask_id,grant_id,physical_epoch,phase WAITING|ACTIVE|STOPPING|TERMINAL,activation_operation_id nullable; ACTIVE requires global activation and own ready/no fence, never replaces private GO
child_dto.open: Server derives owner/attempt/TaskRun/streams from current scoped bootstrap; no owner_id in request. Adapter validates supplied engine identities locally.
child_dto.consumer_identity: Binding.consumer_id is stable EdgePartition.subscriber_id, never TaskRun.id; StreamContext/StreamRunResult use returned ID. Only resolved direct same-graph PAYLOAD business value is returned.
child_dto.StreamDAGProducerFinishReceipt: operation_id,graph_revision_id,producer_subtask_id,producer_stream_id,kind SOURCE_EOF|CONSUMER_EOF,tail_sequence>=0,accepted_source_position>=0|null,accepted_input_sequence>=0|null,semantic_digest,outcome_digest; EXACT ONE coordinate selected by kind
child_dto.finish: No error/key/targets. Current auth/binding before replay; source may replay exact accepted EOF Running/Completed; consumer requires no inflight and fully acknowledged COMPLETED input. Semantic identity excludes owner/attempt. uuid5(producer_subtask_id,'prefect-stream-dag-{source|consumer}-finish-v1').
child_dto.failure: Only current signed terminal Task event or exact internal control; no success-finish error strings/legacy failure hooks
child_dto.auth: Own scoped capability + grant header only. Public lifecycle projection PID-free; private own bootstrap needs registered process identity for FD misdelivery guard.

worker_dto.StreamDAGWorkerAssignment: Own assignment/config/working_directory/current grant; phase STARTING|ACTIVE|STOPPING|TERMINAL; own bootstrap_ready; task/output bounded hints; control{operation_id,kind STARTUP_ABORT|FAIL|CANCEL}|null; COMPLETE own launch_attempts<=64. No Flow capability/sibling config.
worker_dto.coexistence: One supervisor/registry supports P2 and DAG with common two-live-child cap and shared occupancy. Unique(worker,protocol,version) capability rows coexist under same exact principal; P2 poll bytes unchanged; TTL is eligibility, never death.
worker_dto.startup_abort: Server canonical operation and fixed reason; own persisted assignment/current principal + STARTING only; ACTIVE winner -> ACTIVATION_ALREADY_COMMITTED; parent fail may join same canonical STARTUP_ABORT.
worker_dto.prepare: No nominated grant/epoch/index. Server-issued accepted start/replacement authorization derives exact target/grant/epoch/worker generation and next index1..64. One candidate per authorization. PREPARED commits before Popen; replacement appends. Epoch64 forbids new attempt but allows cleanup.
worker_dto.record: Private child gate prevents user import. Record exact PID once before preflight import. Existing PREPARED can record after control won, disposition STOP_REQUIRED; no import. Closed attempt cannot acquire new PID. Worker-local spawn/stop mutex and closed journal prevent late spawn.
worker_dto.StreamDAGLaunchOperationResult: receipt:StreamDAGLaunchOperationReceipt,current:StreamDAGLaunchAttempt,disposition SPAWN_ALLOWED|PREFLIGHT_ALLOWED|STOP_REQUIRED; current/disposition volatile, never spawn from old receipt alone
worker_dto.close: PID_RECORDED requires exact JOURNAL-recorded PID/ticks death proof, including pre-grant child. PREPARED/no-PID requires exact current-worker closed-local-journal attestation after recovery. Unknown stays open and holds capacity; one process birth per attempt.
worker_dto.stop: Server derives/locks COMPLETE frozen-target attempt set, requires every row CLOSED, persists all_attempts_closed_digest before release. No client subset, unstarted boolean, grant selection or TTL/missing-grant shortcut. Every admitted assignment includes no-grant/epoch0 case; only unassigned SEALED preview releases zero slots synchronously.
worker_dto.physical_compatibility: Existing assigned-worker claim/register/renew/replacement endpoints dispatch persisted profile to DAG handlers and derive/link matching recorded attempt; no P2 DTO/body changes. DAG normal retirement and control STOP both require complete CLOSED attempt-set proof before physical release. Dedicated active STOP never widens P2 startup-stop/VerifiedRetirement.
worker_dto.recovery: Same-principal manager recovery reconstructs server-authoritative complete attempt set. Local journal is aid only. Missing proof, new unsupported worker generation or cross-host loss fails closed with capacity held; no ADR47 expansion.

storage_matrix.plumbing: _request/_dispatch restricted to closed DAG methods and exact bootstrap scope; arbitrary names refused. Pure config/_matches reusable. Reflection classifies every base coroutine; a future unclassified method fails.
storage_matrix.server: Independently deny every legacy DATA/open/read/status/finish/reject/fail/create/reserve/register/prefix/child-lease path, sibling, admin/control. Before own ready and ACTIVE no DATA/body/events; own bootstrap/ready/activation allowed. SOURCE input/status -> SUBTASK_SCOPE_DENIED403.
storage_matrix.task_lifecycle: Preallocated exact TaskRun, no ordinary registration/reserve or default server result-store calls. Skip legacy DAG child lease renew/release. Signed event authority alone handles failure; worker/graph owns leases and exact death.

persistence.reuse: Existing StreamPartition, NI011 PAYLOAD/REFERENCE/route receipts, shared occupancy, admission/activation/preactivation-abort, normal retirement primitives. No second store or TaskRun per record.
additions: StreamDAGLifecycleOperation immutable action receipts and terminal FINALIZE basis/summary
Distinct bounded append-only-identity StreamDAGLaunchAttempt with prepare/record/close receipts and grant link
StreamDAGControlTarget exact start/subtask/TaskRun/worker generation/optional grant + complete closed-attempt-set digest
Per-grant immutable bootstrap witness and signed ready
persistence.checks: Profile-scoped FK/unique/checks; DAG registered grant links exact recorded launch; fixed P2 new fields null. RELEASED outcome comes from persisted finalization journal, never guessed from mutable counts.

server.migration_allocation: Server allocates unique paired revision IDs and exact basenames before first DDL edit; no guessed IDs in this wire freeze.

root_ci.rule: Root owns selection, no-skip gates, exact new module types and hosted evidence. Existing P2/client byte-golden regressions retained.

implementation_paths.ownership_rule: Each listed file has one owner. Cross-owner changes require explicit handoff; no overlapping edits.

Control races pre-Popen, pre-record, pre-import, pre-claim, pre-register and pre-ready.

Manager restart recovers all known attempts; unknown proof holds capacity.
One missing CLOSED attempt blocks both STOP and normal retirement release.

Both public SEAL and START refuse remaining automatic Flow retry capacity with zero mutation; exhausted final attempt allowed.
Signed failure/CANCEL races accept events, preserve first control cause/EOF and terminal replay.

Reflection-complete storage deny matrix, scoped HTTP negatives, strict types, package isolation and one source-bound frozen union.
